title: Topa Inca Yupanqui (The Great Navigator)
biography: Son of Pachacuti and tenth Sapa Inca who doubled the empire's territory through campaigns into Ecuador, Chile, and the Amazon, and led a legendary trans-Pacific naval expedition with balsa rafts to Polynesian islands.
internationalConnections: Conquered the Chimú Empire and integrated coastal seafaring traditions into Incan logistics.
